optimizedContext.value:
# CompileContext
## Rules
### Construction
- Inject `ChangeRepository`, `ListWorkspaces`, `SchemaProvider`, `FileReader`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`, `ContentHasher`, `PreviewSpec`, `GetSpecMetadata`, yaml-derived `CompileContextConfig` snapshot.
- Snapshot includes project/workspace context patterns, `projectRoot`, `configPath`, yaml defaults; excludes per-call overrides.
- `SchemaProvider` lazily caches fully resolved schema. `PreviewSpec` supplies merged persisted artifacts+deltas. `GetSpecMetadata` supplies self-healing canonical projection with `policy: if-needed`.
- MUST NOT accept/use `LifecycleEngine` or `ImplementationDetector`; MUST NOT call `SpecRepository.readMetadataSnapshot()`.
### Input and effective config
- `execute`: `name`, entry-point `step`; optional `contextMode`, `llmOptimizedContext`, `includeChangeSpecs=false`, `followDeps=false`, `depth`, `sections`, `fingerprint`. No `config` input.
- Shallow-merge snapshot with runtime `contextMode` and `llmOptimizedContext` only.
- Caller refreshes tracked files via `RefreshImplementationTracking`; compilation uses persisted implementation state.
- Resolve schema first; `schema.name() !== change.schemaName` throws `SchemaMismatchError` before collection.
### Workspace qualification
- Explicit `workspace:path` routes by workspace name. Unqualified project pattern→`default`; workspace pattern→that workspace; metadata `dependsOn`→declaring workspace.
- Unknown workspace qualifier warns+skips; never throws.
### Collection
- Seed `change.specIds` only when `includeChangeSpecs`; always seed `change.specDependsOn` values.
- Seeded `change.specIds` mandatory; excludes cannot remove them.
- Then: project include → project exclude → active-workspace include → active-workspace exclude → transitive `dependsOn` only when `followDeps`.
- Active workspace has spec in `change.specIds`. Traversal starts from `change.specIds`, works in every state, honors `depth`, and additions bypass excludes.
- Consult manifest dependencies before repository access. Check discovered spec existence before registration; unresolved traversal discoveries silently skip.
- Traversal metadata failure warns `missing-metadata` only for persisted specs; stale projection remains usable and warns `stale-metadata`. Use manifest/schema fallback where available.
- Deduplicate in stable first-match order. Output order: direct seeds → `specDependsOn` seeds → include matches → traversal. Source priority: `specIds` > `specDependsOn` > `dependsOnTraversal` > `includePattern`.
### Dependency resolution
- First nonempty tier: `change.specDependsOn[specId]` → `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` canonical dependencies → schema `metadataExtraction.dependsOn` with shared transforms/origin context.
- Schema fallback uses merged preview for change-scoped specs, base artifacts otherwise. Empty all tiers means no dependencies.
- Break repeated cycle edge without warning; retain other reachable specs.
### Display and rendering
- Classify after collection. Default `summary`; supported `list`, `summary`, `full`, `hybrid`.
- `list`: ID/source/mode only. `summary`: ID/title/description/source/mode. `full`: all collected entries full. `hybrid`: only direct `change.specIds` seeded by `includeChangeSpecs` full; all others summary.
- `sections` affects full entries only. Absent: render all spec-scoped artifact files, `spec.md` first then alphabetical, labeled by filename. Present: render selected `rules`, `constraints`, `scenarios` from structured content.
### Change-scoped extracted-first source
- Every collected ID in `change.specIds` uses merged `PreviewSpec` artifact set as PRIMARY source for title, description, and section content in every non-list mode, including specs existing only in change.
- Run schema `metadataExtraction`; Markdown heuristics MUST NOT be primary.
- Fallback: merged-preview extraction → canonical `GetSpecMetadata` projection → base-artifact schema extraction.
- Any usable rung suppresses `stale-metadata`/`missing-metadata`. Preview failure never blocks; use base fallback.
- Lock-owned `optimizedContext` and `optimizedDescription` never apply to `change.specIds`.
### Other metadata/content
- Outside `change.specIds`, structured rendering uses `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })`; materialize rendered specs only.
- Persisted or regenerated valid projection is usable. Regeneration alone is not warning; forward actionable failures such as `metadata-cache-write-failed`.
- No valid projection yields `missing-metadata` plus minimal entry.
- Missing non-traversal spec warns+skips. Full mode without `sections` needs no metadata for body.
### Result
- Return `contextFingerprint`, `status`, `projectContext`, `specs`, `warnings`; no lifecycle/readiness/blocker fields.
- Project context follows declaration order: instruction verbatim; file relative to `specd.yaml`. Missing file warns+skips.
- Fingerprint canonical emitted logical context, diagnostics, result-shaping inputs, and merged delta content; excludes lifecycle state/availability/blockers.
- Matching `fingerprint` returns `status: unchanged` and empty `projectContext`/`specs`; otherwise `changed` with assembled context.
### LLM optimization
- With `llmOptimizedContext: true`, prefer nonempty `optimizedContext`; otherwise standard context.
- Strict bypass optimized context when `sections` lacks either `rules` or `constraints`; `optimizedDescription` unaffected. Requested scenarios still append while optimization active.
- Change-scoped specs always bypass both optimizations and emit no optimization warning.
- Other collected specs: absent value warns `missing-optimization`; drifted baseline warns `stale-optimization`. Both messages include `Launch specd-spec-context-optimizer agent to refresh`.
### Factory
- Config form `createCompileContext(config, options?)` uses `resolveCompileContextDeps(resolver)`, then canonical `createCompileContext(deps)`; no inline fs wiring.
- Resolver supplies `changes`, `listWorkspaces`, `schemaProvider`, `files`, `parsers`, `hasher`, `previewSpec`, `getMetadata`, `extractorTransforms`, `workspaceRoutes`, `defaultConfig`; MUST NOT resolve `LifecycleEngine`.
## Constraints
- Project context precedes spec entries. Missing files/specs warn+skip; unknown workspaces warn+skip.
- Steps 1–4 precede traversal; traversal opt-in; `depth` meaningful only with `followDeps`; traversal additions survive excludes.
- At most one entry/spec; stable collection order and highest-priority source.
- File access only through `SpecRepository` or `FileReader`; caller constructs repositories/readers/config. Active workspace list covers every configured workspace.
- `sections` only affects full content. `contextMode`: list|summary|full|hybrid; default summary.
- `CompileContext` excludes artifact instructions/rules/delta context and hook instructions; use `GetArtifactInstruction` and `GetHookInstructions`.
- Cycle safety mandatory. `PreviewSpec` errors always fall back; never block compilation.
